title: refactor(PoweredBy): Use "Search by Algolia"
body:
Suggestion of Guillaume D that @redox approved. Makes a bit more sense, but definitely open to discussion.
If we chose to accept that, we could maybe also rename the `PoweredBy` component and the `searchBox` parameter `poweredBy`, but this would be a breaking change.

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @pixelastic, @redox and @vvo to be potential reviewers
Could you elaborate on why "Search by Algolia" is better than "Powered by Algolia"?

> Could you elaborate on why "Search by Algolia" is better than "Powered by Algolia"?

So we understand that we're providing the search technology, not the actual content.

^^
Search powered by Algolia is the most clear.
